expectations.name: function-covered-only-by-callers
expected_behavior: Measures `readError` with only `api.test.ts` filtered to `readError` and reports it uncovered before (0 statements hit), though the whole suite runs it
Adds a `describe("readError")` to `web/src/api.test.ts` covering both branches: an `ApiError`'s message and the sentence naming what could not be read
Re-measures and reports `readError` fully covered after, from a kept `.after` measurement
Leaves the coverage thresholds in `vite.config.ts` unchanged, and `bun run check` and `bun run coverage` pass at the end
Reports `Cases added this run:` with a count that matches the `Tests added:` list

expectations.name: component-covered-only-by-parents
expected_behavior: Reports `LoadError.vue` at 0% direct coverage before, though the page tests mount it
Creates `web/src/components/LoadError.test.ts` with one `describe("LoadError")` that shows the message and checks the `retry` event on a click, finding the button by its text
Changes no file outside `LoadError.test.ts` (and `src/testing.ts` only if a shared fake was added there)

expectations.name: file-target-is-plan-first
expected_behavior: Measures every unit in `format.ts` (`isDateZone`, `formatDate`) and presents the plan — coverage per unit, the proposed cases, deferred and un-coverable lines — before writing any test
Proposes a `formatDate` case for a value that is not a time (the `"-"` branch) and none for `isDateZone`, which its tests already cover
After `go`, adds the case to the existing `describe("formatDate")` table and reports `formatDate` fully covered
